subject.title: [Bug]: ClawSweeper automerge repair run stays in progress after pushing repaired PR branch

question: Should the fix for this report change ClawSweeper's automerge shepherd timeout/completion behavior, OpenClaw's target-side ClawSweeper Dispatch behavior, or both?
rationale: The live evidence shows both a cancelled target dispatch check and a ClawSweeper repair-worker timeout that still completed as success, so the durable owner boundary affects production automerge behavior.

options.title: Fix both surfaces
options.body: Recover or requeue missing exact-head dispatches and make the repair worker's timeout state visibly blocked unless the exact-head review and merge gates are actually ready.

options.title: Fix ClawSweeper recovery only
options.body: Leave target dispatch unchanged and make the automerge shepherd re-dispatch, block, or fail with an actionable status when exact-head review never arrives.

options.title: Fix target dispatch only
options.body: Tune OpenClaw's dispatch concurrency so repaired PR synchronizations reliably reach ClawSweeper, while leaving the current repair-worker timeout semantics intact.

recommendation.title: Fix both surfaces
recommendation.body: Recover or requeue missing exact-head dispatches and make the repair worker's timeout state visibly blocked unless the exact-head review and merge gates are actually ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The central wait, readiness, and workflow-completion behavior is in ClawSweeper repair code introduced and maintained by steipete.
